equipo: Windows 11 · Intel64 Family 6 Model 154 Stepping 3, GenuineIntel

mediciones.descripcion: Línea base: solo PKs, FK sin índice, estadísticas al día
mediciones.sql:
SELECT o.order_id, o.order_date, c.customer_name, o.total_amount
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE c.country = 'México'

mediciones.descripcion: Índices cubrientes: customers(country) INCLUDE (...) y orders(customer_id) INCLUDE (...)
mediciones.sql:
SELECT o.order_id, o.order_date, c.customer_name, o.total_amount
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE c.country = 'México'
nodos: Index Only Scan on customers using ix_customers_country
Index Only Scan on orders using ix_orders_customer_id

mediciones.descripcion: Vista materializada con índice (country, order_date, order_id)
mediciones.sql:
SELECT order_id, order_date, customer_name, total_amount
        FROM mv_orders_by_country
        WHERE country = 'México'
nodos: Index Only Scan on mv_orders_by_country using ix_mv_orders_country_fecha

mediciones.descripcion: Consulta con filtro de fecha (último año) sobre orders con índices de E2
mediciones.sql:
SELECT o.order_id, o.order_date, c.customer_name, o.total_amount
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE c.country = 'México'
AND o.order_date >= DATE '2026-01-01'
nodos: Index Scan on customers using customers_pkey
Index Only Scan on orders using ix_orders_customer_id

mediciones.descripcion: Misma consulta sobre orders_part: partition pruning (solo lee 2026)
mediciones.sql:
SELECT o.order_id, o.order_date, c.customer_name, o.total_amount
FROM orders_part o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE c.country = 'México'
AND o.order_date >= DATE '2026-01-01'
nodos: Index Only Scan on customers using ix_customers_country

mediciones.descripcion: Página profunda con OFFSET 100,000 LIMIT 50 (lee y descarta 100,000 filas)
mediciones.sql:
SELECT order_id, order_date, customer_name, total_amount
        FROM mv_orders_by_country
        WHERE country = 'México'
         ORDER BY order_date DESC, order_id DESC OFFSET 100000 LIMIT 50
nodos: Index Only Scan on mv_orders_by_country using ix_mv_orders_country_fecha

mediciones.descripcion: Misma página con keyset: WHERE (order_date, order_id) < (último visto) LIMIT 50
mediciones.sql:
SELECT order_id, order_date, customer_name, total_amount
        FROM mv_orders_by_country
        WHERE country = 'México'
         AND (order_date, order_id) < (DATE '2025-04-12', 5690620) ORDER BY order_date DESC, order_id DESC LIMIT 50
nodos: Index Only Scan on mv_orders_by_country using ix_mv_orders_country_fecha
